tooltip.update-ft.stone_arrow.1: The crudest arrowhead, but it gets the job done.
tooltip.update-ft.copper_arrow.1: Copper tip, just sharp enough to work.
tooltip.update-ft.copper_arrow.2: Strange power might stir in a thunderstorm…
tooltip.update-ft.iron_arrow.1: A sturdy iron tip that rarely lets you down.
tooltip.update-ft.diamond_arrow.1: Cuts through the gaps in any armor.
tooltip.update-ft.netherite_arrow.2: Damage bonus: +4 - the strongest arrow here.
tooltip.update-ft.tnt_arrow.2: Radius 4 - breaks blocks, and hurts you too.
tooltip.update-ft.redstone_arrow.2: Powers the block it hits and triggers nearby buttons, levers and doors.
tooltip.update-ft.pearl_arrow.1: An ender pearl set into the tip.
tooltip.update-ft.pearl_arrow.2: You land wherever it hits, at the cost of 3 fall damage.
tooltip.update-ft.web_arrow.1: Leaves a cobweb under whatever it hits.
tooltip.update-ft.fire_arrow.1: Ignites the target and spreads fire in a 3x3 area.
tooltip.update-ft.fire_arrow.2: The fire spreads - do not shoot your own house.
tooltip.update-ft.bee_arrow.1: Summons 2 bees that only attack the target.
tooltip.update-ft.bee_arrow.2: Bees die after stinging; they leave after 30 seconds.
tooltip.update-ft.frost_arrow.2: Turns 3x3 water surface into melting frosted ice.
tooltip.update-ft.wind_charge_arrow.1: Unleashes a pure knockback burst at the impact.
tooltip.update-ft.grapple_arrow.1: Pulls you toward the block it hits.
tooltip.update-ft.grapple_arrow.2: Pulls a creature 5 blocks toward you.
